name: Vanuatu

format.notes: A written test in Bislama, sat once the application is complete, for applicants on Forms A and B. A fail puts the application on hold until a second test.

unverified.fee: A schedule of fees exists; no amount for the test was read.
unverified.exemptions: Applies only to Forms A and B; nothing else read.

notes: A search summary of the same page says the test covers general knowledge of Vanuatu (legal, political, historical and social); that sentence was not read directly, so its scope as a knowledge test rather than a language test is not fully confirmed.
